title: Ender Mace by HexaFoxx
description: Ender Mace is a plugin that allows you to teleport to the block your looking at in a 10 block radius, amazing for running, active with your offhand bind and fighting.
body:
The Ender Mace isn't just a weapon—it's a movement overhaul. By binding the teleportation ability to your Offhand Key, this plugin allows for fluid, seamless repositioning during intense combat without ever having to stop swinging your sword.

Combat Mobility: The "Blink" Mechanic
Forget scrolling through your hotbar. While holding the Ender Mace in your main hand, simply press your Swap to Offhand key to instantly teleport to the block you are targeting.

Precision Teleport: Targets any block within a 10-block radius.

Zero Latency: Designed for instant response, perfect for dodging projectiles or closing the gap on an enemy.

Tactical Cooldown: A 15-second timer ensures the ability is used for strategy, not spam.

Technical Features
Intuitive Controls: Uses the standard PlayerSwapHandItemsEvent to trigger the teleport, making it feel like a native Minecraft feature.

Safety First: Built-in checks prevent players from teleporting into "suffocation" blocks or through thin walls into restricted areas.

Visual Feedback: End-themed particles and a distinct sound effect accompany every blink, providing clear feedback to both the user and their opponents.

Command

/endermace give <player name>
